body.name: Joint-score representative transition
body.construction: After deterministic normalization, a state is \(\left(\pi_i,a_i\right)\) with \(a_i\in\{0,1\}^r\). For each block, branch on intervention constants and on constants tested there by still-live normalized conjunctions, plus one fresh representative when available; update every flag by conjunction with its coordinate-\(i+1\) tests.
